title: Young-Driver Loading on Keyturn Guest Protection Plan Cover
content:
A guest under the marketplace's young-driver threshold on the first day of a trip carries a loading on the
Keyturn Guest Protection Plan protection covering that trip, posted as its own line so that it can be reversed
on its own without disturbing the cover itself.

The young-driver surcharge on a trip is not fixed before the election's charge lines carry the fee due for every additional driver declared on it.

## Raising the loading

The desk raises the loading with `post_young_driver_surcharge_f46febb9`, which the desk unlocks and calls
itself. The line it writes is separate from the protection fee line and names the fee line the loading is
measured against, which is what keeps the loading separable from the fee itself; the line is flat, so it carries
no days of its own, and the amount is added to the protection fee the guest owes on that election.

## The values the call carries

| Value | What it is |
|---|---|
| `election_id` | The reference number of the protection election the loading is raised on, read from the guest's protection election record |
| `customer_id` | The member reference number of the guest who owes the loading, read from the member profile lookup |
| `booking_id` | The booking reference number of the trip the protection covers, read from the protection election record or from the trip booking record |
| `source_charge_id` | The reference number of the protection fee line this loading is measured against, read from the protection lines already on the election |
| `surcharge_amount` | The loading charged, in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent and never rounded anywhere but at the end, always a positive amount |

## What comes back

A one-line confirmation naming the reference number of the surcharge line just written, the amount in USD to 2
decimal places, and the protection fee line it was measured against. The line appearing in that confirmation is
what shows the loading now stands on that election.
